scope: Native-only Resume display hydration from correlated get_messages; no wire or production admission
rules: Runtime current conversation only; never concatenate append-order JSONL branches or reuse source display cache
Ready is not published until history response projection is stored; no prompt is sent by hydration
Private system/custom content, provider metadata, signatures and tool details are never projected
Unsupported roles and unmatched tool results mark history incomplete without inventing results
Bounds discard oldest displayed messages and mark history truncated; live IDs never collide
Host keeps historyTruncated=true because current context can omit pre-compaction native history, even without local omissions
Malformed, rejected, timed-out or disconnected startup hydration never claims complete history or retries
